related_questions.question: Can I go to work if I have COVID?

text_blocks.snippet: It's not recommended to go to work if you have COVID-19. Public health organizations advise that you should stay home and away from others to prevent the spread of the virus, especially if you have symptoms.
In California, if you test positive for COVID-19 and have symptoms, you must be excluded from the workplace until:
24 hours have passed with no fever, Symptoms are mild and improving, and No new symptoms develop.
Additionally, your employer is required to:

list.snippet: Investigate and respond to COVID-19 cases or close contacts.
Notify employees and independent contractors about potential exposure.
Offer testing at no cost to employees who had close contact at work.
